confidence_notes: FX is the RBA overview page figure for 18 Nov 2026 (0.6720 USD per AUD); a 19 Nov value of 0.6677 appeared in the cached statistics table but I could not confirm it, so I used the confirmed 18 Nov figure. Food anchors come from one search of crowdsourced cost-of-living sites (Numbeo-style and similar). Those sites range from about $8 to $18 for a mid-range meal for two. Beer is thin: about $2.23 in one source and about $6 at tourist venues. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the beer price, because alcohol is scarce and costly in Aswan and sold mostly in tourist hotels. Accommodation figures are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. They are uncertain, and prices vary with the season and with Nile cruise demand.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other Upper Egypt tourist cities such as Luxor, with prices set by local Egyptian levels and tourist-hotel pricing for alcohol.
